answer: In this design, each identity escrows bonded collateral, and correlated equivocation across k coordinated identities triggers pairwise penalties that scale as O(k²), rather than treating each lie in isolation. Because detected sybil control also compounds capital loss exponentially with swarm size, splitting one actor into many identities cannot cheaply evade accountability. A wharf may signal evidence to the haven, but identity count does not dilute the cost.
